title: How a mirror helps you notice yourself
topic: How a mirror helps you notice yourself

screens.heading: What a mirror does
screens.body: A mirror does not tell you who to be. It only shows what is in front of it.

screens.heading: Pause and breathe
screens.body: When you pause and notice your face, your breath often slows by itself.

screens.heading: Just you, here
screens.body: That quiet look is yours. No score. No lecture. Just you, here.

screens.heading: Remember this
screens.body: Later, if the day feels loud, you can remember: noticing is already a kind of strength.

comprehension.question: What does a mirror actually do?
choices: Shows what is in front of it

comprehension.question: What can happen when you pause and notice your face?

video.prompt: Watch a quiet clip of someone taking a calm breath in front of a mirror. What did you notice?
